channel.title: Ganza Consulting — Blog
channel.description: Long-form, no-fluff articles on consulting, process automation and AI, project management and web development — written from delivered engagements.

item.title: The Consulting Retainer Trap: Why Monthly Retainers Rarely Solve Real Problems
item.description: Why most consulting retainers become a subscription to activity, the three cases where they genuinely work, and the renewal conversation that fixes it.

item.title: Small Business Automation: What to Automate First (and What to Leave Alone)
item.description: How to rank automation candidates by payback instead of annoyance, the five that reliably work for small teams, and the maintenance cost nobody budgets.

item.title: Why Your Multilingual Website Isn't Converting (It's Not About Translation)
item.description: Layout that breaks on longer strings, trust signals that don't transfer, and the hreflang mistakes that hide half your site from search engines.

item.title: When Not to Automate: The Hidden Risk of Automating Broken Processes
item.description: Six kinds of process you should not automate, the costs missing from every business case, and a scorecard for deciding what deserves to survive.

item.title: Why ERP Implementations Fail: 7 Failure Modes and the Early Signal for Each
item.description: Seven recurring ERP failure modes from publicly documented cases, the early signal each emits, and a pre-go-live checklist that catches most of them.

item.title: The One-Person Consulting Studio: When Small Beats Big (and When It Doesn't)
item.description: Where a one-person studio genuinely beats an agency, where it doesn't, and the four continuity guarantees to demand before signing with either.

item.title: The Audit Nobody Reads: Why Most Business Audits Fail to Drive Change
item.description: Why a correct 60-slide audit changes nothing, and how to specify a business audit that ends in a decision instead of a PDF nobody opens twice.

item.title: How to Choose a Business Consultant: 9 Questions That Separate Expertise From a Good Deck
item.description: Nine questions to ask before signing, what a good and a bad answer sound like, and how to structure a first engagement that's cheap to walk away from.

item.title: Why Startups Need Consulting (Even the Ones That Think They Can't Afford It)

item.title: How Lidl Lost €500 Million: A Case Study in Digital Transformation Failure
item.description: How customising SAP instead of changing one process burned about €500 million over seven years — and the five checks that catch the same drift early.

item.title: How Much Does Business Consulting Cost in 2026? Rates, Models and What Drives the Number
item.description: Real 2026 benchmarks by supplier type, the four pricing models, the seven factors that move a quote, and how to read a proposal for padding.

item.title: Infrastructure Inbreeding: Why Promoting Only From Within Puts Your Company at Risk
item.description: Why a closed leadership pipeline erodes a company's ability to adapt, the five symptoms that appear before the numbers move, and a 20-minute diagnostic.
